faqSec.title: Before the first conversation
faqSec.lead: Can't find what you're looking for? Write to

faq.q: What does a corporate communications agency do?
faq.a: It shapes how the company is perceived by clients, partners, investors and its own team. At Melo that includes positioning, brand, culture and internal communication, institutional materials, website and video, all under the same direction.

faq.q: What does it mean to turn technical authority into brand authority?
faq.a: Technical companies are often excellent at what they do, but the market doesn't see how big that is. Turning technical authority into brand authority means translating knowledge, processes and results into positioning, identity, content and digital presence that clients, investors and the team itself recognize.

faq.q: Do you only work with health, technology and law?
faq.a: No. We work with any company struggling to turn technical authority into brand authority. Health, technology and law are where this gap shows up most often.

faq.q: What kind of company does Melo work with?
faq.a: B2B and technical companies that already deliver well and need communication to match: clinics and healthtechs, technology and data companies, law firms, education institutions, industry and engineering. Clients include Fleury, Mackenzie, Suzano, Cyrela (SYN) and brain4care.
Six steps: pain mapping, solution alignment, creation, delivery, measurement and correction. The cycle repeats until results hit the goal set at the start.

faq.q: Do you work with companies outside São Paulo?
faq.a: Yes. We are based in Liberdade, São Paulo, and work remotely with companies across Brazil and abroad.

faq.q: How many deliveries have you made?
faq.a: More than 3,000 deliveries and more than 50 brands accelerated in six years.
